discs.label: Vinyl · original 2014 black pressing, side A
discs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is a photographed close-up of the actual Taylor Swift 1989 ORIGINAL 2014 black vinyl side A center label (not Taylor's Version). Reconstruct exactly ONE complete black 12-inch vinyl record in a perpendicular flat top-down view on a truly transparent square background. Entire circular rim must fit with small equal margin. Center the small transparent spindle hole precisely. Black record has realistic fine concentric grooves and three track bands, clean diffuse studio illumination, no reflected photographer, no room/window reflections, no scratches or sleeve. The actual center label occupies approximately ONE THIRD of the whole record diameter and uses precisely the reference's pastel lavender sky, yellow/cream seagulls, hand-painted T.S. 1989 and side A text. Preserve this label's artwork, orientation, typography and track placement faithfully. Do not enlarge label to fill disc; the majority of diameter is BLACK VINYL GROOVES. No album sleeve, no artist portrait, no second record, no background, no cast shadow. This is a reference reconstruction; original label pixels will later be composited over the center for exact lettering.

FOLLOW-UP SURFACE EDIT:
Precise object edit. Remove the ENTIRE large pastel printed paper label from the center of this black vinyl record and replace it with continuous plain BLACK vinyl/deadwax matching the existing black record material. There must be NO paper label, NO illustration, NO lettering, NO artwork anywhere on this output. I will composite an authentic photographed paper label separately afterward. Keep the complete black vinyl rim, realistic fine concentric grooves and three track band divisions. Flat top-down, perfectly centered circular shape, tiny centered transparent spindle hole and truly transparent background. Preserve the existing record diameter and equal margin; no shadow. High-quality clean diffuse material without camera/window reflections.
discs.notes: Complete black vinyl groove field is reconstructed; authentic photographed printed label pixels were perspective-corrected and composited at 212px diameter, with no generated lettering. The groove plate is shared with the other reconstructed black record; detailed groove positions are approximate.
